evidenceLevels.label: structural
evidenceLevels.claim: files, schema, manifest or static validation passes
evidenceLevels.proof: hash, parser, schema or linter output

evidenceLevels.label: isolated-runtime
evidenceLevels.proof: command, exit code, output summary and read-back artifact

evidenceLevels.label: live-runtime
evidenceLevels.claim: a host/Agent runtime (current reference: Open Design or another approved host adapter) executes the capability
evidenceLevels.proof: runtime ID/version, task ID, artifact hash, stage/provenance read-back

evidenceLevels.label: release
evidenceLevels.claim: reviewed exact tree is published with exact-SHA CI evidence
evidenceLevels.proof: commit, push/PR/release, workflow run and remote read-back

evidenceLevels.label: commercial
evidenceLevels.proof: acceptance record, production feedback or delivery sign-off

research-evidence.note: source registry + governance rules structurally present; runtime qualification pending

design-intelligence.note: atoms/scenarios and brief-routing structural checks pass; isolated/live runtime evidence pending

visual-quality.note: rubrics + scoring scripts verified; historical runtime evidence is not reused after tree changes

style-master-method.note: master records exist; source verification and method cards remain Phase 7 work

professional-visual-domains.note: domain packs, scenarios and profiles pass structural verification; live runtime evidence pending

production-handoff.note: preflight/handoff schemas and adapter contracts verified; runtime delivery evidence pending

creative-toolchain.note: adapter/plugin contracts pass structural verification; fresh Open Design runtime requalification pending

release-evidence.note: canonical CI was green on the audited main baseline; this tree still requires human acceptance, independent review and release evidence for E4

hardRules: Static files do not prove host runtime availability.
Model or VLM self-score alone does not prove design quality.
Reference-only or license-unclear material cannot enter runtime prompts as absorbed content.
A previous successful CI run on another SHA is not release evidence for the current tree.
Commercially proven requires external acceptance, not an internal demo.
